{{Quote|I am General Brimon Yarar. Welcome to our little project.|Brimon Yarar to Han Solo and his family|<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />}}
'''Brimon Yarar''' was a [[General/Legends|General]] in the [[Speciesism|anti-alien]] [[Human League]], and lead the group's [[Human League Heritage Squad|Heritage Squad]]s.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Drall planetary repulsor just came alive.''"''<br />''"''What?!''"''<br />''"''Just now, sir. The jamming is still in place, of course, so we can't get any more information. But our sensors just picked up a huge jolt of repulsor activity coming from Drall. Unfocused, uncontrolled, but it's there. The Drallists have got the thing working.|Brimon Yarar and Thrackan Sal-Solo|<ref name="Showdown at Centerpoint">''[[Showdown at Centerpoint]]''</ref>}}
Yarar was from the northern reaches of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] main landmass. At some point after [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], he joined the Human League; an anti-alien extremist group founded by [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]], a former member of Corellia's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] government. By [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], he had risen to the rank of General and oversaw a large excavating operation on the planet by the League's Heritage Squads, under the guise of a simple archeological dig to learn about early [[Human/Legends|human]] history on Corellia &mdash; its actual purpose being to uncover an ancient underground [[Planetary repulsor|repulsor]]. He gave a tour of the dig site to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her [[Solo family|family]], during which [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], and [[Anakin Solo]] broke away from the tour and found the repulsor, but decided not to tell the General, having seen through his friendly facade.<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" /> Later on, after the Human League began an [[Corellian Crisis|insurrection]] to take control of the entire [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], Yarar informed Sal-Solo of [[Drall (planet)|Drall's]] repulsor being activated, incorrectly believing the [[Drallist Front]] had done it.<ref name="Showdown at Centerpoint" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Do you want that General What'shisname&mdash;''"''<br />''"''Yarar.''"''<br />''"''Right, Yarar. He's no nice guy, no matter how hard he smiles.|Jacen Solo and [[Q9-X2]]|<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />}}
Yarar was a middle-aged, slightly larger [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Gender/Legends|man]] with dark skin, short dark hair, and a toothy smile. He held anti-[[Alien/Legends|alien]] sentiments to the point that he refused to even acknowledge the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and the [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] [[Ebrihim]] when they accompanied the Solo family on their tour of Corellia's planetary repulsor digsite. He had a soft voice which contained a slight accent from the northern regions of Corellia's main landmass.<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />

==Equipment==
Yarar wore a dark [[Color/Legends|brown]] uniform of a severe cut, a hat, and metal-toed black boots, as did the rest of the Human League's members, though minus the group's armband. His hat was slightly more elaborate than those worn by lower-ranking members, and an elaborate insignia designating his rank of General was pinned to his tunic's shoulder boards.<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />
